title: ratchet-tree-options-02: full -01 to -02 audit (mls_partial_group_info wire format 0x0010)
description: mimid moved to rto-02 by citations (f477a3b) and one fix (a0cbee0) only; no full diff audit. -02 §6.1 registers MLS wire format mls_partial_group_info (0x0010 suggested, from Mark's issue #2); mimid has no reference to it. Audit -01 to -02 (112 changed lines) against mimi-mls wire/ratchet_tree_options.rs, observer/member, mimi-protocol GroupInfoOption; decide whether mimid emits/accepts the new wire format.
close_reason: Audit: mimid conforms to every normative -01 to -02 change; no code or fixture change. httpsUrl rename (wire unchanged); optional<Node> already decoded (decision .4.29); PartialGroupInfo-with-ratchet_tree rejected (decision .4.30, now stated by -02); signature covers only included extensions (observer.rs); ratchet_tree last (a0cbee0). mls_partial_group_info 0x0010 is registered but never used in the -02 body; MIMI-07 §5.3 carries PartialGroupInfo bare in GroupInfoOption (verified), so mimid neither emits nor accepts 0x0010. Open WG questions already tracked in .37.91.1 (#7, #9, #10, PR #8).
